In this episode we are going to be looking at Azure Art Markers. These are markers that I was able to find at Walmart for $10. I was instantly interested in testing them out to see if they were going to be valuable to a professional artist or is the old saying true, " You get what you pay for."  I will be putting these markers to the test while giving you my very honest and professional opinion on this product.  Let's give it a look and see if this product is actually WORTH IT!?

Is it worth it is a series where products that are meant or can be used by artist will be used and tested. At the end there will be a review and a verdict made as to whether or not the product is worth it. This will be a very honest review of products. Just remember that this is just one artist's opinion and should not be considered as law. This series is just being made to try and help those who are looking to get a little bit more information before buying.
